review_scope: Method only; no new source queries, no candidate decision, no master mutation, no statistical or BaZi hypothesis.
overall_assessment: Compound-place geography can refine an already accepted literal birthplace, but a map showing that one same-named compound exists is not by itself a positive identification of the biographical referent. Bounded no-counterexample search is a limitation check, not proof of worldwide uniqueness. The protocol is sound only if its sufficient-coverage clause is implemented through the gates below rather than used as an after-the-fact discretion to admit a match.

material_risks.detail: An authoritative source can verify Lowther Street in one Carlisle while saying nothing about which Carlisle the birth source meant. Source authority establishes its own geographic claim, not the person-to-place linkage.
Two UK-only sources, or two sites copying the same national map or place record, add positive support for one candidate but are not two independent tests of possible global alternatives.
Removing case, spaces and punctuation is not equivalent to changing Blencoe to Blencow or Blencowe. A spelling substitution requires an observed original historical-alias statement.

Do not choose a convenient distance threshold for near or exclude a settlement merely because a current type differs. Type and relation exclusions must derive from the original wording and an observed candidate record, with historical relevance assessed when it affects the result.

Search pagination, indexing, language and feature-class limits matter. A structured global catalogue is not complete merely because it is global in name; a failed or truncated response provides no negative coverage.

decision_gates_in_order.name: Frozen birth-source bridge
decision_gates_in_order.pass_requirement: Use only the already accepted literal birthplace and its explicit qualifiers or relationship. Preserve native identity, dates, original grades and old evidence; verify the source collector has not substituted a parental, employment, education or death location. No new person binding is created by the geography step.

decision_gates_in_order.name: Complete compound positive identification
decision_gates_in_order.pass_requirement: At least one original authoritative geographic or historical source must explicitly identify the entire distinctive compound or a documented equivalent, including the relevant child-place/parent-place relation and a region whose extent permits a hemisphere decision. Matching a familiar parent name plus a separate, unrelated child-name hit fails. A county name in a webpage footer fails.

decision_gates_in_order.name: Identity of geographic names and temporal compatibility
decision_gates_in_order.pass_requirement: Exact literal matching may normalize only case, spacing and punctuation. Any spelling or historical-name bridge must be explicitly documented. Assess historical compatibility proportionately: do not demand an exact-year map when immaterial, but do not assume a modern renamed road or relation existed at birth when the decision relies on that equivalence. A proposed modern county is reference geography, not an assigned historical birth-country field.

decision_gates_in_order.name: Independent discriminating support
decision_gates_in_order.pass_requirement: Seek a second independently authored/compiled geographic witness or a candidate/type catalogue that adds information capable of distinguishing alternatives. Record shared or unknown data lineage. Repetition of the same national-map record is corroboration, not an independent discrimination step.

decision_gates_in_order.name: Bounded alternatives coverage
decision_gates_in_order.pass_requirement: Retain the actual searches and accessible candidate lists for the complete raw compound and relevant parent/child names, without choosing a country first. Record all compatible and excluded candidates, exact reasons for exclusions, limits and failures. A region-restricted source cannot stand in for this coverage. Do not describe an empty search as proof that no alternative exists.

decision_gates_in_order.name: Residual ambiguity review
decision_gates_in_order.pass_requirement: A main-table hemisphere proposal is eligible only when gates1–5 provide a positive, well-supported identification and no material unresolved alternative remains. All observed compatible candidates must agree in hemisphere; however agreement of observed candidates alone does not pass if the supporting coverage or referent bridge is inadequate. An observed opposing-hemisphere compatible candidate, unsupported alias, incomplete critical response or materially uncertain relation requires unknown.

decision_gates_in_order.name: Versioned geography-only application
decision_gates_in_order.pass_requirement: If eligible, record the inference as geographic disambiguation with separate geographic-support grade, source provenance, alternatives and stated coverage limits. Do not call it a new birth sentence or upgrade the original birthplace/DOB tier. Assign no country, unique place QID or personal birthpoint coordinates. Independent source/context QA must pass before root applies a result.

outcome_categories.meaning: Positive compound referent identification plus discriminating support and adequately reviewed alternatives; hemisphere may be proposed conditionally on documented source coverage, never described as mathematical worldwide uniqueness.

One or more sound sources establish a possible matching compound, but do not sufficiently identify the birth-source referent or distinguish other plausible compounds. Save the geographic observation; master remains unknown. Any exploratory sensitivity use must be a separately labelled field and must not silently alter the principal hemisphere.
Contradictory compatible candidates, unsupported alias, materially incomplete lookup, missing original source or unjustified type/relation restriction. Preserve all evidence and unknown.

target_specific_checks.required_checks: Observe the street-to-locality relation directly and the parent region; a Lowther Street elsewhere plus an unrelated Carlisle result does not form a compound. A modern local street record alone gives a candidate, not global disambiguation.

Retain Little and near Penrith. If a source instead uses Blencow/Blencowe, demand explicit historical alias evidence. Do not repair the spelling silently or define an ad-hoc near radius to select a candidate.

Verify Church End as the named child locality or historical area of the relevant Finchley, not merely a street called Finchley Road. Both generic child and parent terms must be positively linked in original geographic evidence.

target_specific_checks.literal: Carleton, a small village near Carlisle
target_specific_checks.required_checks: Retain village and near Carlisle. Show an observed settlement relation, not an estate, road, station or surname. Exclude a candidate by type only when the exclusion follows the birth wording and historically relevant evidence, not because it is outside the anticipated region.

operational_recommendations: Record these interpretation gates before the root evaluates source proposals; if changing the original protocol, retain both versions and the amendment timestamp rather than backdating the change.
A request-budget stop can legitimately yield candidate_support_only or hold; do not lower the evidence bar to obtain a nonzero batch.
Keep biography-source identity confidence, birthplace-source grade and geographic-disambiguation confidence as distinct fields.
No source queries or substantive data decisions were made by this reviewer. This review does not approve any of the four candidates.
